base_contract.anomaly_policy: 異常候選保留primary；排除版僅sensitivity，非corrected performance；不得依報酬調參。
base_contract.external_source_policy: Exact relative paths and SHA256 allowlist; raw paid TDCC CSVs remain outside Git. Recovered one-day quote and seven-stock warmup official JSONs are authorized for this new research family only; no changes to original receipts. Warmup supplements only valid missing pre-signal observations; valid main rows take precedence after numeric equality check when both valid.
base_contract.financial_scope: 不使用月營收；EPS、毛利率、營益率、營業利益、業外損益、淨利、季度與年度財報均不在範圍。
base_contract.history_gap_policy: 缺交易所日觀測不前填；揭露缺日。lag為有效觀測lag，不冒稱固定交易所日lag。已有資料的異常幅度不作剔除門檻。
base_contract.numeric_feature_serialization: four decimal places before frozen selector evaluation
base_contract.operation: next exchange session open=D0; exit=calendar[entry_index+h],h=5/10/20; each horizon independent same-stock locks; signal_date must be strictly greater than prior exit_date; no intraday execution, no queue, no stops or take-profit
base_contract.outcome_revision_policy: Same pinned current main price version; historical first publication unproven.
base_contract.phase_policy: phase_classifier_not_invoked; explicit empty phase/status for the frozen research v2 enum fallback branch; not a reconstruction of old mixed candidate inputs
base_contract.price_feature_reference: 7ef37a966280201a5ee236856306fdb513de7092:scripts/build_stock_price_history.py:add_indicators,round_numeric_columns; previous_20d_high_ex_today is an explicitly pinned low-level lagged-high definition, not a strategy threshold change
base_contract.price_features: 同股有效日觀測序列，civil weekday排除週末，row有效日期須等於檔名日期；只用date<=signal_date的歷史休市事件前綴排除休市日副本，逐日列出實際影響，未來closure不改decision序列，詳本版external calendar與固定main exceptional calendar之依賴與缺證；return_5d/20d=close/lag(5/20)-1，百分比；volume_ma20、high_20、low_20含當日；previous_20d_high_ex_today為前20觀測high最大值；volume_ratio=current shares/mean(last20 shares)；volume_ma20_lots=shares/1000。至少21份有效觀測，不借用其他模型60日gate。
base_contract.return_basis: 同時保存strict_v3_status及raw_price_cashflow_unadjusted研究proxy。有OHLC可計實際數值的成本後價格proxy，不等於公司行動核實總報酬，不等於券商成交。strict v3公司行動缺證時仍open_unresolved_exit；proxy帳本則依固定預定close結束，明示其無公司行動假設。
base_contract.selector_semantics: 原研究v2 enum fallback，不宣稱等同正式production phase classifier；禁止調參。
base_contract.source_data_coverage_limit: 55 TDCC weeks include four warmup weeks and do not represent 55 evaluable weeks. 20260911 is absent and outside this contract. 91-prefixed possible TDR is labeled. Five recent identities 3717/4441/7610/7765/7780 are not spliced.
base_contract.source_version_policy: 使用目前取得歷史版本的 research-only 回放。所有 decision/outcome 日價固定於 price_source_ref 的 data/daily_price/YYYYMMDD.csv；TDCC 僅使用明列55份私有歷史版本、有效日<=signal。原發布版本及當時可得性未核實，不是strict PIT。舊 receipted replay 及其 receipt flags 完全不改。
base_contract.tdcc: 明列55份私有FinMind原文之有效日不晚於signal_date的最後四批；400張以上為400,001-600,000、600,001-800,000、800,001-1,000,000與more than 1,000,001四級比例之和；1000張以上為最高級。調整及total列不納入。400/1000最後比例減第一比例，up=count(diff>0)，使用固定classify_accumulation原函式；四批或任一必要比例缺少則unsupported，不將缺值當0。
base_contract.universe: 每個歷史訊號日原始行情中四位且不以0開頭的證券；保留91開頭可能TDR並標記，不使用今日存活名單或all_candidates。這是股票型代碼母體，不宣稱全部已逐檔核實普通股分類。
base_contract.volume_confirmed_breakout_policy: not independently generated; False explicitly means no second model-owned breakout flag; frozen selector still computes its own OHLCV attack exclusion
base_contract.volume_quality_policy: 任一使用中20觀測來源仍標示TPEX_OLD_DAILY_JSON，量比/均量lineage unresolved；保留母體與指標、不得列supported selector/trade。新版明確使用已修復且固定SHA的main每日行情；不修改舊receipt版本或回測證據。
base_contract.warmup_policy: 新版history_start=20250401，涵蓋已取得日价最早20250407；七股八份官方月行情補充缺失之有效暖機觀測。不新增60日或固定21市場日連續gate，不拼接3717/4441/7610/7765/7780前身。每股最後21個現有觀測及其OHLC完整性沿用凍結consumer；缺日只揭露，不前填。
